items.summary: Heads up: the /config command only edits the claude config for THE CURRENT PROJECT, NOT your global config. The UI really should indicate this, super annoying. ClaudeDevs (@ClaudeDevs) You can now set Claude Code's output style to Concise. Claude leads with the result, keeps responses short, and still gives full detail when you ask. Turn it on in /config → Output style, or set "outputStyle": "Concise" in settings.json. — https://nitter.net/ClaudeDevs/status/2090245922685063634#m
